areas.name: Barackos
areas.note: Broad orchard/residential transition around the actual fruit-named streets north of Telki út. Planning text separately identifies Barackos and Meggyes/Darányi; outer northern track/field links are inferred and do not reproduce a zoning parcel boundary.

areas.name: Hidegvölgy
areas.note: Estimated valley locality north of Pátyi út around Tölgyfa/Vadász and the former forestry-industrial compound. It can overlap the separately preserved industrial-park child. Western hillside and northern garden transitions are approximate, not a whole-parent substitution.

areas.name: József Attila lakótelep
areas.note: Compact estate envelope at the József Attila/Erkel/Tulipán street group. Municipal nursing-district text explicitly distinguishes the József Attila estate from the rest of that street. Adjacent Honvéd-lakótelep is not treated as a verified alias; southern open-space transitions are inferred.

areas.name: Meggyes
areas.note: Orchard/garden locality estimated using the saved field-track network west of the named Meggyes/Fenyő streets and the stream bend. Outer garden links are inferred; no single orchard parcel is substituted for the whole neighborhood.

areas.name: Pilisi Parkerdő Ipari Park
areas.note: Estimated industrial compound envelope around the actual internal circulation roads. Operator directions identify entry from Tölgyfa and building17 in the valley; short perimeter links are inferred from road layout. This child remains distinct from Hidegvölgy.

areas.name: Szőlőskert Ipari Park
areas.note: Industrial/commercial park neighborhood estimated from its named street/access network and officially listed park addresses, including adjoining undeveloped park land. Outer lot transitions are approximate; the Tesco/Oázis building footprints alone are not used as neighborhood bounds.

areas.name: Tiefenweg
areas.note: Distinct garden/valley street group south of Pátyi út around Tiefenweg, Szüret and Lugas. The named road and stream fabric anchors the estimate; western orchard limits and the transition toward Szőlőskert are inferred. The German place name is not blindly merged with Hidegvölgy.
